sections.heading: Core principle: your entries stay on your device
sections.body: ConcreteCalc calculates concrete volumes, bags, mixes, screed, bulk materials, block quantities and material costs entirely on your device. Dimensions, prices and results are processed only as current screen state unless you save them in a project yourself. Stored permanently are the selected appearance, the default reserve, the last confirmed Pro status and – with Pro only – the projects you create (project name, entries, results and time saved). The app also stores the selected unit system, the last chosen units and a counter for the rating request. To choose metric or imperial units automatically, it reads the country of the SIM card, otherwise the country of the mobile network or the region from the device settings; this information never leaves the device. There is no user account, no own server, no advertising and no analytics or crash-reporting SDK. Android backups are disabled.

sections.heading: Purchases via Google Play
sections.body: ConcreteCalc Pro unlocks projects and PDF export and is a one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription. You can also leave an optional tip in three tiers; it unlocks nothing and can be bought more than once. Google handles payment and account data as an independent controller. The app receives only the product ID, purchase state, acknowledgement state and a purchase token, which it uses to acknowledge the Pro purchase or to mark a tip as consumed, never payment details. The unlocked Pro status is stored locally and queried again at Google Play regularly so that refunds take effect. The app does not store tips.

sections.heading: Sharing results and PDF export
sections.body: Only when you choose Share result does the app hand the displayed result text including your entries to the Android share dialog. You choose the receiving app; its own privacy policy applies to what it does with the text. With Pro you can also share a result or an entire project as a PDF. The file is created in the app's cache and handed only to the app you choose; it is replaced by the next export.

sections.heading: Deleting data
sections.body: Unsaved entries disappear as soon as you change them or close the app. Delete individual calculations and whole projects in the app under Projects. Remove stored settings, projects and the local Pro status via Android → Apps → ConcreteCalc → Clear storage, or by uninstalling. A purchased Pro entitlement stays with your Google Play account and can be restored in the app.

sections.heading: References to other apps
sections.body: Settings show a "More apps" area with other apps by the same provider. The list is included in the app and, when you open Settings, refreshed at most once every 24 hours from a public GitHub repository. Technically, this transmits your IP address to GitHub. No entries, results or other information about you are sent, and the list is not personalised. Opening an entry launches the Google Play Store, for which Google is independently responsible. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in informing you about our own apps (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you have, in particular, the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. App data is generally stored locally under your control, so you can inspect, change or delete it there. For data in a Google account used voluntarily, Google is the relevant contact.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This privacy policy is updated when the app, the services used or the data processing changes. The current version is available in the app and at the linked address.
